articles.title: A Rocket Crashed Into the Moon — and NASA Just Found the Hole!
articles.summary: A SpaceX rocket part smashed into the Moon on August 5. NASA's orbiter finally snapped a photo of the crater it left behind. The hole is about 60 feet wide and less than 10 feet deep.

articles.title: A Damselfly Peeking Through a Leaf Wins Big Photo Prize
articles.summary: A photo of an orange-tailed damselfly looking through a hole in a leaf won a big nature photo contest. The tiny insect is a sign that wetlands are healthy. Other winning photos show frogs, cuttlefish, and sea turtles.

articles.title: Mysterious 'Little Red Dots' in Space Might Be Baby Black Holes!
articles.summary: Astronomers found a weird glowing object called a 'black-hole star' that shines 100 billion times brighter than any normal star. It might be a baby supermassive black hole wrapped in a gas cocoon. This could explain the universe's biggest black holes.
